children: RNS Number : 0703V  Ashmore Group PLC  16 September 2026

Ashmore Group plc (the "Company") announces that in accordance with UK Listing Rule 6.4.1, a copy of the 2026 Annual Report and Accounts (the "Annual Report") has been submitted to the FCA and will shortly be available for inspection via the National Storage Mechanism at: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism

In accordance with Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 6.3.5R(1A), the Annual Report contains regulated information in unedited full text. The Annual Report is also available on the Company's website: www.ashmoregroup.com.
